'''Sivor''' was a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] worker drone under [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Piddock]]. He ran errands and was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] technician. He was killed by [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo's]] spy, [[Thweek]] in a gladiatorial bout.<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />
